description: This file defines a Zustand store for managing attachment upload/download progress, encryption progress, and related actions within the Notesnook project. It includes types, store state, and methods for updating attachment progress, removing attachments, and setting download/upload states.

classes.name: AttachmentGroupProgress
classes.description: Type representing progress details for an attachment group, including total, current, groupId, filename, and status flags.

classes.name: AttachmentStore
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of the attachment store, including progress tracking, encryption progress, and methods for updating state.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an attachment by hash, updates progress to 100%, and calls the editor controller to set attachment progress.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Sets the progress for an attachment (upload or download), calculates progress percentage, and updates the editor controller.

methods.name: setDownloading
methods.description: Updates the downloading state for a specific attachment group.

methods.name: setUploading
methods.description: Updates the uploading state for a specific attachment group.
